key_highlights: RBA hiked the official cash rate to an 18-year high, prompting recession warnings from major Australian banks.
ASX 200 finished higher post-decision led by relief rallies in retail and airlines, despite sharp declines in oil and energy stocks.
Australian housing market downturn accelerates with price falls nearing a 40-year record as mortgage distress intensifies.
Westpac posted a $6.8B profit while forecasting an 11% property price decline; credit conditions tighten across the financial system.

sectors.trend: Net interest margin expansion offset by surging mortgage stress, bad debt risks, and expected housing slump.
sectors.implications: Banks face mounting credit headwinds and slowing loan origination despite solid statutory profits.

sectors.trend: Global oil prices tumble amidst geopolitical instability and recessionary demand destruction, while domestic diesel supply risks loom.
sectors.implications: Earnings downgrade risks for major oil and gas producers; margin compression for upstream operators.

sectors.trend: Pilbara iron ore volatility, gold sell-offs, and critical minerals exploration driving divergent sub-sector performance.
sectors.implications: Pressure on bulk miners and bullion producers, balanced by selective exploratory momentum in critical minerals.

sectors.trend: Short-term relief rally on ASX clashes with deteriorating household disposable income, retail store closures, and Christmas spending fatigue.
sectors.implications: High vulnerability to margin contraction and revenue declines as higher repayments squeeze consumer budgets.

sectors.trend: Property prices falling for a seventh consecutive month, compounded by negative gearing tax shifts and 18-year high debt servicing costs.
sectors.implications: Valuation write-downs and liquidity constraints for residential and commercial property trusts.

key_themes: RBA monetary tightening to an 18-year peak amplifying mortgage stress and macroeconomic slowdown.
Severe Australian housing market correction approaching historical records.
Commodity price divergence with crude oil slump and gold capitulation against ongoing bulk export dependencies.
Consumer spending curtailment and impending corporate restructuring ahead of the holiday period.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Severe Domestic Recession & Mortgage Default Escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-beta consumer cyclicals; favour defensive high-quality balance sheets and cash reserves.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Collapse and Asset Impairments
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to leveraged residential REITs and non-bank lending institutions.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Energy Disruption and Diesel Shortages
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport and supply chain logistics costs; monitor strategic fuel reserves.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Sovereign and Consumer Debt Refinancing Squeeze
risk_assessment.mitigation: Prioritise companies with low debt-to-equity ratios and fixed long-dated borrowing structures.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on M&A and corporate restructuring in consumer retail
opportunities.rationale: Undervalued brand assets facing cyclical lows are attracting offshore private equity and trade suitors.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate resilient major bank dividend yields on dips
opportunities.rationale: Major lenders maintain strong provisioning buffers and capital ratios despite property headwinds.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to critical minerals and strategic transition resources
opportunities.rationale: Long-term decarbonisation demand supports domestic niche resource plays despite broad commodity swings.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to rate-sensitive residential REITs and discretionary retailers
defensive_moves.rationale: Mounting mortgage repayments and house value downgrades threaten consumer demand and asset valuations.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge broad market downside against domestic recession and oil volatility
defensive_moves.rationale: Risk of an extended slowdown as rate hikes hit peak transmission to the real economy.

market_outlook.short_term: Heightened volatility and downward pressure on the ASX 200 as aggressive monetary policy impacts consumer demand and loan quality.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued recovery contingent on RBA rate peaking, stabilisation of property prices, and resilient Asian commodity export demand.
key_catalysts: RBA post-meeting minutes and monetary policy statement
